messages:
Vera: dropped a quick prototype link for minimap <-> main chart sync. goal: when user zooms in on minimap we should: 1) sync main viewport, 2) optionally highlight outlier annotations that fall inside selection. figma: https://figma.redwood/minimap-sync
Jin: nice. Q: should annotations persist when panning/zooming? I think they should if the underlying point is still in view, otherwise hide them. also prefer a subtle halo instead of big pins so we don't clutter. :sparkles:
Rosa: annotation affordance: two states: condensed (small dot + outline) and expanded (card with value + reason). hover/focus expands. keyboard users need a way to cycle annotations (press "n"/"p" to go next/prev).
Gabe: implementation idea: backend returns three lanes: downsampled_buckets, annotation_points (with flags like severity), and raw_on_demand. front-end can render buckets and overlay annotation_points; when user expands an annotation fetch raw range if needed. sample annotation: {"ts":1680001000, "raw":12345, "severity":"high", "note":"deploy spike"}.
Vera: copy: in-card CTA should be 'Show full range' (toggles chart scale) and 'Add note' for analysts. keep CTAs short. Also label the annotation severity like 'Spike (deploy)'.
Jin: accessibility: A11yCheckBot flagged that floating annotation cards can be missed by screen readers. require: each annotation should be a focusable element with aria-describedby containing human-friendly text like 'Spike on 2026-03-05: 12,345 tokens. reason: deploy'. Also include role=button for the expand action.
A11yCheckBot: checklist: focusable annotation dots (tab order), visible focus rings, aria-live polite for newly appearing annotations, and ensure contrast of annotation dot >=4.5:1. Provide keyboard shortcuts doc for cycling annotations.
Rosa: legend interaction: when annotation belongs to a hidden series, show a muted badge 'hidden series' in the card with a CTA to 'Show series' which un-hides it and highlights baseline. This prevents confusion when annotations reference collapsed series.
Gabe: perf: annotate only top-N by severity to avoid DOM blowup. default N=10. backend can pre-rank by severity or recency. Also provide p95/p999 in series_summary to help client decide which annotations to surface.
Vera: smoothing interaction: if smoothing is ON, annotations should indicate whether the flagged point is a raw extreme or a smoothed artifact. show small label 'raw spike' vs 'smoothed blip'.
Jin: small-screen behavior: annotations become stacked cards under chart; minimap shows selection strip and a count badge like '+3 annotations'. tapping the badge scrolls to list. keep keyboard navigation consistent.
Rosa: UX copy: change 'Toggle units' label to 'Display' with options 'Compact / Exact'. avoid symbols in customer-facing UI. also show localized full values in tooltip.
Gabe: API sketch: response shape -> {downsampled:[], annotations:[{ts, raw, severity, series_id, reason}], summary:{p50,p95,p999}}. front-end can request annotations with ?since=&until= params matching minimap selection.
Vera: action items: Gabe 1 draft API example and severity ranking; Jin 1 add keyboard flows + a11y text samples; Rosa 1 design condensed vs expanded annotation states and copy variants. I'll update figma with annotation halo + collapsed card examples. target review next Mon. :calendar:
Jin: noted. adding a small note to doc about aliasing when zooming (downsampled vs raw) so annotations don't jump.
Rosa: thanks all. leaving comments on figma frames 3/4 about card padding and hit area. :thumbsup:
